description: This file is a C++ source file implementing functions related to CUDA fusion in PyTorch's JIT compiler, specifically for the fuser interface in the torch::jit::fuser::cuda namespace.

classes.name: CudaFuserInterface
classes.description: Interface class for CUDA fuser operations, accessed via getFuserInterface()

methods.name: getFuserInterface
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the singleton CudaFuserInterface instance

methods.name: compileFusionGroup
methods.description: Compiles a fusion group node for CUDA execution

methods.name: runFusionGroup
methods.description: Runs a fusion group node on CUDA

methods.name: fuseGraph
methods.description: Applies fusion to a computational graph if enabled

methods.name: canFuseNode
methods.description: Checks if a node can be fused

methods.name: InsertProfileNodesForCUDAFuser
methods.description: Inserts profiling nodes for CUDA fuser

methods.name: profileNode
methods.description: Profiles a node for CUDA fusion

methods.name: skipNode
methods.description: Determines if a node should be skipped during fusion
